Nick is a tricycle driver. He lives in a small kubo near the sea. Every morning he cleans Nick’s tricycle and checks the wheels. It’s a hot day, so he fills a bottle with water. A girl waves at him. "Please take me to the school," she says. Nick nods, and she hops in. The road is bumpy, but the girl does not mind. At the school gate she pays 5 pesos. "Mabuhay!" says Nick. Then he drives back to find the next rider. He likes his work.
